dosing_regimen.source_excerpt: protocolSection.armsInterventionsModule.interventions; protocolSection.armsInterventionsModule.armGroups: "Secukinumab" "Study treatment was provided in pre-filled 1 mL syringes." "Secukinumab (AIN457) 150 mg" "Secukinumab (AIN457) 300 mg" "Placebo" "Placebo was provided in pre-filled 1 mL syringes." "Placebo" "Secukinumab (AIN457) 150 mg" "Participants assigned to secukinumab 150 mg were dosed weekly for five weeks, then once every four weeks up to and including Week 132." "Secukinumab (AIN457) 300 mg" "Participants assigned to secukinumab 300 mg were dosed weekly for five weeks, then once every four weeks up to and including Week 132." "Placebo" "Patients assigned to placebo were dosed weekly for five weeks, then at Week 8 and Week 12." "At Week 16, placebo patients were randomized in a 1:1 ratio, to receive secukinumab either 150 mg or 300 mg and were dosed weekly for five weeks starting at Week 16, then once every four weeks up to and including Week 132." "BIOLOGICAL" "BIOLOGICAL" "PLACEBO_COMPARATOR" -- The registry has one Secukinumab intervention for both 150 mg and 300 mg arms, so the typed dose is left null rather than choosing one arm's strength. Arm descriptions state weekly dosing for five weeks followed by every-four-week dosing through Week 132; placebo is weekly for five weeks, then at Weeks 8 and 12 before Week 16 randomization to secukinumab. The schema has no phased-frequency representation, so frequency and duration are null. Route and injection form follow the registry's sub-cutaneous injection text and pre-filled syringe descriptions. CT.gov identifies Secukinumab as BIOLOGICAL, identifies Placebo by name and the corresponding arm as PLACEBO_COMPARATOR, supporting the placebo flags.

study_schedule.source_excerpt: resultsSection.participantFlowModule and protocolSection.outcomesModule: "The study was made up of 4 periods: screening, treatment period 1, treatment period 2 and post-treatment follow-up." "Treatment Period 1 (0-16 Weeks)" "Treatment Period 2 (16-132 Weeks)" "Follow-up Period (132-140 Weeks)" "In treatment period 1, participants were randomized in a 1:1:1 ratio to secukinumab 150mg, secukinumab 300mg or placebo." "In treatment period 2, placebo participants were re-randomized in a 1:1 ratio to secukinumab 150mg or secukinumab 300mg." "The follow-up period occurred 8 weeks post treatment period 2 (12 weeks post the last dose of secukinumab)." "Percentage Change From Baseline in Nail Psoriasis Severity Index (NAPSI) After 16 Weeks of Treatment" "Participants assigned to secukinumab 150 mg were dosed weekly for five weeks, then once every four weeks up to and including Week 132." "Participants assigned to secukinumab 300 mg were dosed weekly for five weeks, then once every four weeks up to and including Week 132." "At Week 16, placebo patients were randomized in a 1:1 ratio, to receive secukinumab either 150 mg or 300 mg and were dosed weekly for five weeks starting at Week 16, then once every four weeks up to and including Week 132." -- Registry participant-flow periods state treatment period 1 at Weeks 0–16, treatment period 2 at Weeks 16–132, and follow-up at Weeks 132–140; a separate recruitmentDetails string also identifies screening but gives no screening duration. Therefore overall participation duration including screening is unknown, while end_of_study_week is 140 relative to first dose. The follow-up is stated as 8 weeks after treatment period 2 (and separately 12 weeks after the last secukinumab dose); that 12-week statement is not converted to a visit interval. Week 16 is stated as the placebo rerandomization point. The primary outcome is after 16 weeks of treatment. Period duration 116 weeks is the exact difference between the stated Week 16 and Week 132 bounds. full_visit_table_available is false because this CT.gov file contains narrative periods, not a per-visit schedule table.
